standard_body_boundary.heading: Bibliography
standard_body_boundary.basis: text after this heading is appended resolution/errata material; kept outside base structure census and indexed separately from PDF annotations

method: Reused unchanged source caption locations and ancestor-owner reconciliation; recomputed statuses and literal Table N mentions against current ledger. Citation search is global, not restricted to owner row.
limits: Structural ownership and an explicit citation do not establish every table-entry feature or its implementation/test coverage.
An absent literal citation is a triage candidate, not a missing-feature finding. Plurals, ranges and other citation forms may be missed.
Notes, errata, prose algorithms and normative cross-references require separate feature review.
